principles.title: Use the approved blue visual foundation
principles.requirement: Use #0B5FFF as the primary action color, #E8F1FF as the light surface, #073B9A as the dark interaction state, and neutral backgrounds; define them as reusable design tokens rather than scattered literals.

principles.title: Do not communicate state by color alone
principles.requirement: Pair color with text, iconography, shape, or another visible cue for status, validation, selection, and destructive actions.

principles.title: Keep interactive experiences accessible
principles.requirement: Use semantic controls, visible keyboard focus, programmatic labels, sufficient color contrast, and reduced-motion support where motion is present.

principles.title: Support desktop and mobile layouts
principles.requirement: Define behavior for at least one mobile width and one desktop width, prevent horizontal overflow, and keep primary actions usable without hover.

principles.title: Design complete interaction states
principles.requirement: Specify and implement relevant empty, loading, success, error, disabled, focus, and destructive-action states for the POC scope.
